examples.en: Local politicos gathered at the hall to discuss the new budget.
examples.vi: Các chính khách địa phương đã tập hợp tại hội trường để thảo luận về ngân sách mới.

senses.vi: chính khách; con buôn chính trị

thesaurus.definition: a person active in party politics

wiktionary.gloss: A politician.
Someone involved in the professional life of a politician or a political campaign to varying degrees.
A prominent activist.
Someone with strong views regarding a political cause.
Someone who follows politics regularly and is knowledgeable about at least the political news in their local area.
Any species of the family Nyctibiidae within the order Nyctibiiformes related to the nightjars (order Caprimulgiformes), and found from southern Mexico to southern Brazil.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Hellenic *-íd͏̌d͏̌ō Ancient Greek -ῐ́ζω (-ĭ́zō)

thesaurus.definition: a wild or unrefined state
a genre characteristic of (or imitative of) primitive artists or children

vi_block: Phái gnuyên sơ (trong (nghệ thuật), bắt chước (nghệ thuật) mộc mạc của người cổ sơ).
Lý thuyết cổ sơ luận (cho thời cổ sơ là tốt đẹp hơn thời văn minh hiện đại).

wiktionary.gloss: The state or quality of being primitive.
The opinion that life was better or more moral among primitive peoples, or among children, and has deteriorated with civilization.
Any of a group of related styles in the arts, influenced by a belief in the superiority of primitive forms.

blocks.etymology: From Latin raspatorium. Compare French raspatoir. See rasp.

wiktionary.gloss: A surgeon's rasp.

blocks.etymology: From renominate + -tion.

examples: The renomination of the controversial candidate was not received well.
wiktionary.gloss: The act of renominating, of nominating again.

blocks.etymology: From Old French renoun (compare with Modern French renom), equivalent to re- + noun.

senses.definition: the state of being widely known, admired, and respected for achievements

examples.en: She gained international renown for her groundbreaking scientific research.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã đạt được danh tiếng quốc tế nhờ nghiên cứu khoa học mang tính đột phá của mình.

examples.en: The city is home to several artists of great renown.
examples.vi: Thành phố này là quê hương của nhiều nghệ sĩ có tiếng tăm lẫy lừng.

thesaurus.definition: the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed

wiktionary.gloss: Fame; celebrity; wide recognition.

blocks.etymology: From Old French renoun (compare with Modern French renom), equivalent to re- + noun.

wiktionary.gloss: To make famous.

blocks.etymology: From Latin singulāre tantum (“singular as such; singular only”), from singulāre + tantum.

wiktionary.gloss: A noun (in any specific sense) that has no plural form and is only used with singular verbs. Frequently for mass nouns.

blocks.etymology: From slog + away.

wiktionary.gloss: to work hard at something, often for a long time and in a tedious or exhausting manner
A species of small dolphin (Stenella longirostris).

blocks.etymology: From Latin squāmātus (“scaly”).

wiktionary.gloss: Covered in scales.

blocks.etymology: From the taxonomic name Squamata, from Latin squāmātus.

wiktionary.gloss: Any reptile of the order Squamata; a lizard, snake or mosasauroid.
To squint.
A chipmunk.

blocks.etymology: From New Latin stasis, from Ancient Greek στάσις (stásis). See the doublet stead.

senses.definition: A state or condition in which there is no movement, progress, or change.

examples.en: The economy fell into a prolonged period of stasis.
examples.vi: Nền kinh tế rơi vào một thời kỳ đình trệ kéo dài.

senses.vi: sự đình trệ; tình trạng bất động

senses.definition: The slowing down or stopping of the normal flow of bodily fluids, especially blood.

examples.en: Poor circulation can lead to venous stasis in the lower legs.
examples.vi: Tuần hoàn kém có thể dẫn đến ứ máu tĩnh mạch ở cẳng chân.

senses.vi: sự ứ máu; sự ứ dịch

senses.definition: A state of suspended animation often used in science fiction where time seems frozen.

examples.en: The astronauts were placed in stasis for the long space journey.
examples.vi: Các phi hành gia được đặt vào trạng thái ngủ đông cho chuyến du hành vũ trụ dài.

senses.vi: trạng thái ngủ đông; trạng thái ngừng đọng thời gian

thesaurus.definition: an abnormal state in which the normal flow of a liquid (such as blood) is slowed or stopped
inactivity resulting from a static balance between opposing forces

wiktionary.gloss: A slackening or arrest of the blood current, due not to a lessening of the heart’s beat, but to some abnormal resistance of the capillary walls.

examples: His company was sized for growth, not stasis.
wiktionary.gloss: Inactivity; a freezing, or state of motionlessness.

examples: I was in stasis for forty years before I woke up orbiting this poxy planet!
wiktionary.gloss: A technology allowing something to be artificially frozen in time, so that it does not age or change.
One of the sections of a cathisma or portion of the psalter.

blocks.etymology: From tail + feather.

thesaurus.definition: the biblical tree in the Garden of Eden whose forbidden fruit was tasted by Adam and Eve

wiktionary.gloss: One of the trees in the Garden of Eden. In Christian tradition, Adam and Eve eating its forbidden fruit was the original sin that led to the fall of man in Genesis 3.

examples: Low income and poor health are two sides of the same coin.
wiktionary.gloss: Two aspects of the same thing.
Two things that superficially appear to be opposites but are fundamentally similar.
